source_evidence_statements: research/feedback_control_20261028.md records Espressif esp_audio_effects HOWL 1.4.2 as an embedded FFT-based component with per-bin PAPR, PHPR, PNPR and optional IMSD criteria, dynamic biquad notches and a loop-margin gain controller.
the same note records v1.4.2 support at 8, 16, 24, 32, 44.1 and 48 kHz with fixed 512-sample frames at 16 kHz and 1024-sample frames at 48 kHz, and independent per-channel operation.

the same note records that the library is an ESP-IDF/SoC component rather than a portable host library, and that vendor CPU and memory figures are for ESP32-S3R8/ESP-IDF and must not be generalized to this workstation.

the same note records that v1.4.2's published Espressif Modified MIT license restricts use to Espressif products and prohibits redistribution for non-Espressif products, so it is not an eligible implementation for this macOS/Python target without a license/platform change.
